manifest.name: Neon Night
manifest.description: Advanced example theme: dark neon palette, web font (Google Fonts - requires internet; embed a base64 font for offline devices, see docs/themes.md), glow / motion effects, and a custom logo injected by js.

js: (function() { var DONE = 'data-neon-logo'; var BOLT = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" height="{h}" viewBox="0 0 32 32"><path d="M18 1 L6 18 h8 L12 31 L26 12 h-9 z" fill="rgba(0,229,255,0.15)" stroke="#00e5ff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>'; function swap() { document.querySelectorAll('svg.esp3dlogo').forEach(function(s) { if (s.getAttribute(DONE)) return; s.setAttribute(DONE, '1'); var h = s.getAttribute('height') || '50px'; var span = document.createElement('span'); span.innerHTML = BOLT.replace('{h}', h); s.style.display = 'none'; s.parentNode.insertBefore(span.firstChild, s); }); } var obs = new MutationObserver(swap); obs.observe(document.body || document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true }); swap(); })();
